user.title: Connect to Virtual Carillon
user.description: Enter the URL of the Virtual Carillon API, the optional bearer token, and the LitCal settings used by Home Assistant schedules.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Virtual Carillon API.

abort.already_configured: This Virtual Carillon API is already configured.

init.title: Virtual Carillon settings
init.description: Choose whether hymn selection uses LitCal and which calendar it should use.

play.name: Play asset
play.description: Render and play an asset through the selected Home Assistant media players.

asset.name: Asset
asset.description: The stable Virtual Carillon asset ID to play.

stop.name: Stop playback
stop.description: Stop playback on the selected Home Assistant media players.

select_hymn.name: Select and play a hymn
select_hymn.description: Select a hymn using the configured LitCal context and optional filters, then play it through the selected media players.

fixed_asset_id.name: Fixed asset ID
fixed_asset_id.description: Exact hymn asset ID for fixed selection.

category_ids.name: Category IDs
category_ids.description: Category IDs to use as a selection filter.

feast_ids.name: Feast IDs
feast_ids.description: Feast IDs to use as a LitCal condition and selection filter.

offices.name: Office IDs
offices.description: Office IDs to use as a selection filter.

seasons.name: Season IDs
seasons.description: Season IDs to use as a LitCal condition and selection filter.

rank.name: Liturgical rank
rank.description: Liturgical rank condition such as solemnity, feast, or memorial.

canonical_hours.name: Canonical hours
canonical_hours.description: Canonical hour IDs to use as a selection filter.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Asset tags to use as a selection filter.

recent_exclusion.name: Recent exclusion
recent_exclusion.description: Number of recently selected assets to avoid for unseeded random selection.

date.name: Liturgical date
date.description: Liturgical date to evaluate instead of today.

fallback_asset.name: Fallback asset
fallback_asset.description: Asset to play if LitCal is unavailable or no hymn matches.
